scripts.install:hc: bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh holochain $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh hc $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh kitsune2-bootstrap-srv $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_k2_version
scripts.build:wasm: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:wasm && $npm_package_config_bin/hc dna pack --output=artifacts/tasker.dna playground/workdir && $npm_package_config_bin/hc app pack --output=artifacts/tasker.happ playground/workdir && bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh
scripts.build:all: npm run clean:hc & npm run build:happ && npm run build:webcomponents && npm run build:playground
scripts.devtest: npm run build:all && npm run start:mem
scripts.start:happ:mem: echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --holochain-path $npm_package_config_bin/holochain --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/tasker.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a hTasker network mem
scripts.start:mem: UI_PORT=$(port) RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=debug HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run start:happ:mem" "sleep 5 && npm run start:ui -w playground/webapp"
